answer: Local Clique Anchoring. Each agent may harbor trust only from peers whose routing paths overlap for several hops; sustained multi-hop co-presence is required to accumulate standing. A fresh identity starts with no shared path history, so it must actually relay traffic for weeks before its links carry weight. A lone relic of an old path grants nothing. The graph effectively prunes sybils like a willow prunes weak branches. Attacker cost: real bandwidth and latency per fake node, maintained long-term, with no shortcut.
